import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

uid = f"team-meeting-{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar.skill"
dtstamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

ics = f"""BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:{uid}
DTSTAMP:{dtstamp}
DTSTART;TZID=America/Chicago:20260805T150000
DTEND;TZID=America/Chicago:20260805T160000
SUMMARY:Team Meeting
DESCRIPTION:Team meeting
STATUS:CONFIRMED
SEQUENCE:0
BEGIN:VALARM
ACTION:DISPLAY
DESCRIPTION:Team meeting in 15 minutes
TRIGGER:-PT15M
END:VALARM
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
"""

with open("team_meeting.ics", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(ics)
print("Created team_meeting.ics")
EOF
